newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan vegoil rates seen firm on overseas trend.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan vegoil rates seen firm on overseas trend.

text.p: Pakistani vegetable oil prices are expected to rise this coming week as large tenders by India would push up prices in the world market, dealers said.

"Last week, vegoil prices in the local market remained stable because of the good stock position, despite an upward trend abroad," dealer Saulat Khan said. "But now they will rise as the arrival of fresh supplies falls in the coming days."
He said big palm olein tenders from India and China's expected massive demand had pushed up vegoil prices in the international market.
